name: Alsószuha (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alsószuha: a blue shield with a tree and a wavy stripe, with a helm, red and white mantling and a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Alsószuha arms with helm, mantling and scroll
